project_type: AWS AI League game agent - Lambda-based multi-agent system orchestrated by Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
build_system: pytest for tests, no build step needed
verification_instructions: Run python -m pytest tests/ and confirm all tests pass
setup_instructions: No special setup - pure Python with standard library
environment_constraints: Has internet access. No Docker needed. Tests are self-contained with no network calls.
contribution_requirements: Branch is fix/memory-store-retrieve, 1 commit ahead of main
key_patterns: System prompts are plain text files (*_system_prompt.txt). Lambda handlers in *.py files. The supervisor prompt is extremely concise - every word matters for token efficiency. The game evaluates ONLY the final text response. Tool calls happen before the response text.
directory_structure: Flat structure: all Lambda handlers and system prompts at repo root. Tests in tests/ directory.
